source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Outside an **[Attached unit](vsdata:core-rule/attached-units)**, this unit can't be seen by enemy models more than 12″ away, and an **[[INDIRECT FIRE]](vsdata:core-rule/indirect-fire)** weapon can target it only from within 12″. **Lone Operative X″** uses X″ instead of 12″.

In an Attached unit:

- It benefits only if every model has Lone Operative.
- If models have different ranges, the highest among those on the battlefield applies to the whole unit.
- Once below Starting Strength, it regains Lone Operative as soon as every remaining model has it.

Examples:

- A **CHARACTER** with Lone Operative leading a bodyguard unit with Lone Operative 15″ uses 15″ for the whole unit.
- A **CHARACTER** with Lone Operative leading a bodyguard unit without it regains Lone Operative once every bodyguard model is destroyed.
